Local Tastes
Dal Baati Churma
Rajasthan's signature dish — hard-baked wheat rolls cracked open over ghee, served with spiced lentils and sweet crumbled churma.
Spice Court · Laxmi Misthan Bhandar
Pyaaz Kachori
A flaky deep-fried pastry stuffed with spiced onion, invented and popularised in Jaipur's Old City sweet shops and eaten as a breakfast snack.
Laxmi Misthan Bhandar · Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
Ghewar
A disc-shaped, honeycomb-textured sweet soaked in sugar syrup and topped with rabri, traditionally made in Jaipur for the Teej and Raksha Bandhan festivals.
Laxmi Misthan Bhandar · Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
Food Delivery
Zomato
Foreign number: not required. — signs in with an email address instead of a phone number, so a visitor without an Indian SIM can still create an account.
Covers nearly every restaurant and sweet shop in Jaipur with live tracking, and its ratings closely track Google Reviews; ordering to a hotel room number instead of a street address occasionally confuses new drivers.
zomato.com
Swiggy
Foreign number: not accepted. — international login targets NRIs ordering to a recipient already in India, not a visitor's own foreign SIM inside the country.
Wider restaurant reach than Zomato in some Jaipur neighbourhoods and generally faster delivery windows, but a foreign-SIM visitor typically needs a local number to complete sign-up at all.
swiggy.com

Getting Around
Uber
Foreign number: accepted. — the verification code arrives by SMS on a foreign carrier as long as the carrier allows international short-code delivery, which most do.
Wide coverage across Jaipur with upfront pricing and no haggling, though wait times can stretch during Old City traffic and drivers sometimes cancel on narrow bazaar lanes.
uber.com
Ola
Foreign number: accepted. — OTP now delivers to international numbers, and station-side Ola Point staff can book a ride in person if it fails.
Usually the cheaper option against Uber on short hops and has more autos and bike taxis in its network, though the app's interface is less polished for first-time foreign users.
olacabs.com

Worth Knowing

The Pink City is painted, not built, that colour

Jaipur's terracotta-pink walls are a coat of paint, not the stone underneath — the entire Old City was whitewashed and then painted pink in 1876 to welcome the Prince of Wales, and a municipal bylaw still requires shopkeepers inside the walled city to keep the colour up.

Amber, Jaigarh and Nahargarh forts are physically connected by a single defensive wall running along the ridge — the same fortification system behind the Amber–Jaigarh walking trail, since that trail follows a section of the original rampart road.

Jaigarh Fort's cannon foundry cast the Jaivana, the largest cannon on wheels ever made, and it was fired only once — as a test shot in 1720, said to have landed the cannonball 35 km away and left a crater that filled to form a lake.
